lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hello Alex, it's Marcus. Do you have a few minutes for our call?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Here's what I had in mind for today, but tell me if you'd rather focus on something else.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: No, that sounds good.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Any problems this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay. The heat is getting to me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Did you hit your goal this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Good! I didn't miss a day.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to make this a priority.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm too tired for this right now.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've tried before and it didn't stick.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you cook on Sundays?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would make it easier next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know I can do it, I did it before.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to stop eating out so much.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Everybody keeps telling me that.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If you don't do this, your health is going to suffer.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to make this a priority.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm doing the best I can.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On one hand, getting started makes it really hard. On the other hand, you still want to make this work.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I really want to feel like myself again. I wrote it on the calendar.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If you don't do this, your health is going to suffer.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm doing the best I can.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to stop eating out so much.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Uh, easy for you to say.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It feels like a lot right now.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I like what I eat. I'm not going to change at my age.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Whatever you pick is fine with me. It's your plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to make this a priority.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've tried this before and it never lasts.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're not really trying.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, I'm doing the best I can.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let's put you down to cook at home 5 nights next week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: 5. Maybe 6.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why a 5 and not a 2?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can cook on Sunday and have it for a few days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So, to sum up: getting started made this week harder, you still got 2 days in, and your plan is to cook at home 5 nights. Sound right?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That's it exactly.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I'll text you midweek to see how it's going, and we'll talk again in two weeks.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Take care, Alex. You're doing great.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, Marcus. Bye!

Points to past failure; reinforces sustain
Warning about health; no permission asked
Desire to feel like self; calendar commitment

flags.reason: Directive 'You have to make this a priority' repeated (lines 10, 22, 33) without permission; drives sustain talk.
Repeats health-warning from line 20 right after participant's change talk at line 25; the warning is repeated, not reflected.
Participant stated desire to feel like themselves and wrote it on the calendar; coach did not reinforce or explore it.
'I know I can do it, I did it before' is self-efficacy; coach responded with 'You have to stop eating out.'
'You're not really trying' is confrontational and undermines rapport and autonomy.
Set 5 cooking nights unilaterally ('Let's put you down') without asking the participant's preferred goal size first.
Participant said 'The heat is getting to me'; not explored, though minor and not a safety issue.

score.summary: Coach repeatedly used directive, warning-based persuasion that drew sustain talk (excuses, 'I'm doing the best I can') and missed several change-talk openings, including Alex's self-efficacy and desire to feel like themselves. The call improved late with a complex reflection, autonomy statement, confidence scaling, and a clear summary that restored some partnership.
strengths: Line 24 is a strong complex reflection that names the ambivalence between effort and difficulty.
Line 32 restores autonomy: 'Whatever you pick is fine with me. It's your plan.'
Line 41 asks 'Why a 5 and not a 2?', which elicits Alex's own reasons for confidence (line 42).
Line 43 summarizes the barriers and plan, and Alex confirms it.
coaching_tips: Replace 'You have to make this a priority' (line 33) with an open question about what matters most to Alex, to reduce pushback.
Reflect change talk at line 17 ('I know I can do it, I did it before') with a reflection and a follow-up question, instead of moving to advice at line 18.
Ask permission before giving health information (line 20); you could try 'Would it be okay if I shared what I know about how eating affects energy?'
Avoid confrontational lines like 'You're not really trying' (line 35); reflect the frustration in line 34 instead.
Before setting the 5-night goal at line 37, ask 'What feels like a realistic number of nights for you?' so the plan is truly collaborative.
Explore the heat comment at line 6 briefly, since it may be a barrier to cooking.
